title: TÉCNICO EM LOGÍSTICA PL – RHA3916
description:
Venha fazer parte de uma empresa que ama transformar com tecnologia e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Apoio na execução e diligenciamento do processo logístico de movimentação de materiais envolvendo depósitos geridos pela Unidade, garantindo conformidade físico-contábil-fiscal.

Principais Serviços a serem realizados, mas não limitados a:

Suporte às atividades de logística

Criar/atender reservas e diligenciar as reservas, realizar movimentações contábeis, PTM (Pedido de Transferência de Material - convencional e simplificado) de movimentação de materiais e/ou documentos equivalentes;

Sanear reservas vencidas;

Conferir materiais recebidos, notas Fiscais e efetuar a regularização nos sistemas de controle da Petrobras (ex.: YSMONITORPORT, MIGO, etc.);

Liberar materiais para utilização;

Criar Requisições de Transportes (RTs) e diligenciar o atendimento;

Emitir Notas Fiscais;

Atualizar arquivos, controles e sistemas;

Analisar protocolos de notas fiscais e tomar ações para regularização;

Suporte à gestão de depósito de materiais

Gerir estoque de sobressalentes, planejando e executando as ações necessárias para garantir o atendimento à demanda;

Emitir FCDRs (Fichas de Controle de Disposição de Resíduos) e GRMAs (Guias de Remessa de Material para Alienação);

Realizar inventário de materiais envolvendo depósitos terrestres geridos pela Unidade, atendendo aos prazos estipulados;

Identificação e contagem física de materiais;

Conciliação estoque físico e contábil de materiais;

Atualizar arquivos, controles e sistemas;

Analisar as movimentações contábeis dos depósitos a fim de verificar lançamentos indevidos;

Suporte à fiscalização dos serviços

Planejar, criar, liberar, confirmar e encerrar notas e ordens de manutenção, beneficiamento e restauração, incluindo compras de materiais para atendimento aos serviços;

Cadastrar equipamentos e materiais, planos de manutenção;

Atualizar arquivos, controles e sistemas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Imprescindível:

Diploma de Técnico de Logística, Técnico de Administração, Técnico de Suprimento ou Técnico em Contabilidade, com diploma expedido por instituição de ensino reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC)

Conselho ativo

Conhecimentos Necessários:

Domínio do Módulo de Materiais (MM) do SAP ERP;

Pacote Microsoft Office;

Domínio da língua vernácula e habilidade de redação técnica;

Especialista em materiais e equipamentos de sua área de atuação.

Informações adicionais

Local: Imboassica - Macaé/ RJ

Escala 12x36 - 7 às 19 horas

title: Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)
description:
Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS) role at Canonical

Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS)

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager (Backend SaaS) role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an engineering manager to lead the reboot of our Landscape systems management solution for Ubuntu.

Ubuntu is growing rapidly in the enterprise, with estates expanding from cloud, to bare metal servers, to vSphere clusters, and of course desktops and devices. Ubuntu is easy to deploy and configure, one node at a time, but it's difficult to know where you stand on policy and compliance, patch management, or access control across a large estate. Ubuntu used to be under the radar in the enterprise, but it is now becoming an official platform for many companies. Those enterprises very much want a high quality way to manage their Ubuntu estate.

We started work on Landscape many years ago, and the current generation of the service reflects the choices of the day. We now have the opportunity to invest significantly in a team to bring a fresh new vision for large-scale Ubuntu estate management to the project. That doesn't make this a greenfield opportunity - we have a system that serves thousands of deployments - but we know we want to step back and give it a big new push, letting go of some things that are no longer so important, and embracing a range of new priorities. This role is the critical engineering leadership role for that mission.

Today we use Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, HAProxy, and have a ReactJS front end. In other web services projects we use more Golang these days. Our next wave of Landscape engineering is an opportunity to raise the bar on SAAS and on-prem solution technologies, architectures, patterns and operations. Our goal is to make it easy for enterprises to own a few Landscape instances that serve their global estate, and to be able to apply policy and know intuitively where they stand - globally - in a very complex world of mixed Ubuntu versions, substrates and flavours.

Engineering managers at Canonical bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of their teams. You will work closely with product managers, and produce an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals. A successful applicant will be capable of growing a team of engineers, collaborating with other engineering and business teams at Canonical, and providing periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your region
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel 4-6 weeks per year for internal and external events

Valued Skills And Experience

  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Job description

A pessoa coordenadora comercial será responsável por coordenar a área comercial da empresa. Planejando, acompanhando e implementando o processo de captação de novos parceiros (agências, operadoras, DMCs, escolas e empresas) e atuando na gestão da equipe de vendas em pontos de venda físicos localizados em hotéis parceiros. Será o elo entre a operação, marketing e time de campo, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, execução eficiente e o alcance das metas comerciais. Conduzirá ações de captação, relacionamento com parceiros e supervisão da performance das equipes de venda através de KPIs, promovendo melhoria contínua, capacitação e motivação.



Main responsibilities
  • Garantir atingimento das metas de vendas dos canais de atendimento B2C e de relacionamento B2B, apoiando a gerência através das reuniões semanais de resultados e apresentação e relatórios com o resultado e planos de ação caso necessário para recuperação da receita.
  • Garantir atingimento das metas de Receita, realizando as vendas de maneira diligente para que a margem entre receitas e despesas operacionais se mantenha saudável dentro dos parâmetros pactuados em meta.
  • Realizar interface com o time de Operações para garantir nota mínima pactuada de avaliação dos serviços prestados por parte dos clientes que compram nos canais sob responsabilidade do Coordenador.
  • Apoiar no desenho dos processos da área bem como garantir a realização de todas as etapas, respeitando as interfaces com demais departamentos e suas SLAs.
  • Coordenar as equipes de vendas e comercial garantindo o suporte adequado no dimensionamento de equipe e recursos necessários para o desenvolvimento das atividades e metas pactuadas. Garantir o desenvolvimento individual, um ambiente saudável de trabalho e garantindo um plano de sucessão.


Requirements and skills
  • Ensino Superior completo.
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA será considerado um diferencial.
  • Sólida experiência anterior em função comercial no setor de turismo (receptivo, DMC, operadora, hotelaria ou atrativos).
  • Experiência prévia com gestão de pessoas, equipes comerciais ou de vendas.
  • Domínio de KPIs de vendas.
  • Pacote Office, especialmente Excel e Power Point.
  • Inglês fluente (espanhol é um diferencial).

Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo.

  • Pensamento crítico e excelência para resolver problemas de forma prática e eficiente;
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade para lidar com diferentes contextos com leveza;
  • Empatia e inteligência emocional na gestão de pessoas e relações;
  • Senso de dono e comprometimento com a entrega;
  • Integridade e respeito pelas individualidades do time e do cliente;

  • Paixão pelo que faz e disposição para inovar no dia a dia;
  • Comunicação clara e transparente, com abertura para troca e escuta ativa.

title: Gerente de Projetos
description:
At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.


The Role

Kyndryl Project Managers oversee the delivery of major projects within scope, schedule, and budget. You’ll be the driving force for every aspect of a program’s success, and the “conductor” who orchestrates everyone’s efforts to make beautiful music together. As the single point of contact to the client, you’ll also be the living embodiment of Kyndryl’s reputation every day.

As Project Manager, you have command of a very full and detail-oriented calendar. You’ll be constructing detailed project plans, managing teams, and leading meetings, status calls, and planning and cadence meetings. You will analyze and mitigate risks, manage finances, make sure the team has the right skills, then plan and delegate activity to hit deadlines, deliver on SLAs, and generally delight our clients. Of course, plans often evolve as a project unfolds, so you’ll need to practice continuous structural thinking and take ownership for value delivery, not just task scheduling.

But as important as planning and organization are, communication is 90% of the job. You’re the single point of contact with the client, partners, and all stakeholders, supporting them and ensuring they get what they need. You’re also the bridge to every other team on the project, including both technical and account roles. The result is an exciting multicultural, often multilingual environment. Bottom line: You need to like interactions with other people and know how to be kind and empathetic but also assertive — and handle customer change requests with diplomacy.

You’re going to be meeting a lot of people, networking, and forging relationships. Our “one team with the customer” concept means you’ll develop especially strong partnerships with the client and elsewhere. Some projects or clients even involve “embedding” with the client at their location. This puts more visibility on you personally, but it also gives you more opportunity to add value to the relationship. This is one of the things Kyndryls love about working here. It’s a great way to hone your service and people skills, and it lays the groundwork for career growth both laterally and vertically.

Your future at Kyndryl
Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications. You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a senior project manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of PM roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Experience

  • SCRUM or Project Management skills
  • Basic TI knowledge (architectural)
  • Organization and planning skills
  • Teamwork with “one team” philosophy
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal)


Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  • MS Project or other Project Management software
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learningprograms give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, includingMicrosoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Asset Geologist
description:
Employer company TotalEnergies EP Brasil Ltda

Context & Environment

A posição exige que o profissional trabalhe em uma equipe multicultural de geociências, desenvolvimento e ativos de joint venture.

O ativo Iara é um desenvolvimento em águas ultraprofundas na Bacia de Santos do pré-sal brasileiro, com várias acumulações separadas (Berbigão, Sururu, Atapu). Os reservatórios são carbonatos lacustres complexos e heterogêneos, com incertezas significativas em geociências (dupla porosidade e permeabilidade), desafios em geomodelagem, e todos são desenvolvidos com um processo avançado de recuperação WAG (injeção alternada de água e gás). A gestão das incertezas de subsuperfície é um elemento-chave para o desenvolvimento ideal e a gestão subsequente dos campos.

Os campos dentro da Concessão Iara e do PSC Atapu são operados pela Petrobras, com atualmente 2 FPSOs em operação e um terceiro em engenharia/construção. Os campos ainda estão em desenvolvimento, com perfuração de poços em andamento, estudos de poços de infill e implementação ativa de gestão de reservatórios. A TotalEnergies é um parceiro importante nesses campos, e a equipe GSR é um componente essencial dentro do ativo Iara, visando garantir um desenvolvimento seguro, lucrativo e maximização de valor.

A integração entre as disciplinas de Geociências e Reservatórios, e outras entidades não-GSR (incluindo Projeto, Engenharia, Operações de Campo, Perfuração e Completação) é fundamental para o sucesso geral do desenvolvimento dos campos e otimização da produção.

Atividades Principais

  • Contribuir para os estudos de 2G&R e projetos dedicados do ativo, analisando, validando e integrando novos dados sísmicos e de poços em um esquema geológico consistente.
  • Auxiliar o geofísico sempre que necessário em tarefas multifuncionais como interpretação sísmica, calibração de poços e análise de dados sísmicos.
  • Implementar e contribuir, junto ao engenheiro de reservatórios, para sínteses dinâmicas e revisões de campo.
  • Avaliar os modelos geológicos e de reservatórios existentes, propor e justificar aquisições de dados e estudos de geociências e reservatórios visando melhorar as avaliações dos campos do ativo Iara.
  • Construir e atualizar regularmente os modelos geológicos conforme novos dados se tornem disponíveis.
  • Acompanhar operações de subsuperfície e aquisição de dados de poços com o geólogo de operações de subsuperfície e, sempre que necessário, auxiliar o operador com propostas proativas sobre preparação operacional e decisões.
  • Implementar, acompanhar e garantir a consistência dos estudos especializados realizados pela sede da TotalEnergies e empresas de serviços externas.
  • Identificar incertezas geológicas para estudos de análise de risco e realizar avaliações de volumes in situ com suas respectivas incertezas.
  • Representar a Geologia de Reservatórios em reuniões técnicas com parceiros e entidades terceiras.
  • Influenciar e convencer os parceiros do ativo Iara sobre o valor agregado das propostas da TotalEnergies na disciplina geológica.
  • Garantir comunicação adequada com a sede, parceiros e autoridades no campo da Geologia de Reservatórios.
  • Contribuir com o retorno técnico à sede sobre comportamento de campo, dados de poços e reservatórios, metodologias e ferramentas.
  • Compartilhar o conhecimento adquirido sobre o ativo em termos de modelagem geológica com outros ativos, aprimorando o conhecimento da subsidiária em 2G&R sobre carbonatos lacustres dos depósitos do pré-sal brasileiro.
  • Garantir a implementação e execução de métodos adequados de gerenciamento de dados G&G.
  • Aplicar as regras dedicadas da TotalEnergies para garantir a proteção patrimonial dos dados de geociências.

Responsabilidades

  • HSE: Garantir conformidade com as diretrizes relevantes e regras da empresa. Realizar treinamentos adequados para melhorar seu comportamento em HSE. Respeitar e fazer cumprir as regras de HSE, inclusive no que diz respeito à confidencialidade das informações. Antecipar questões ambientais relacionadas ao negócio e implementar ações corretivas, reportando anomalias.
  • Convencer o operador do ativo e os parceiros sobre decisões de Geologia de Reservatórios.
  • Garantir que um programa ótimo de aquisição de dados de Geologia de Reservatórios seja realizado, e propor o padrão ideal de poços com as localizações mais adequadas para maximizar o valor do ativo.
  • Participar da construção e atualização do banco de dados geológico do ativo.
  • Garantir que os modelos estáticos de reservatórios estejam operacionais e devidamente atualizados.
  • Garantir que a aquisição e interpretação de dados de Geologia de Reservatórios sejam realizadas de forma eficaz e alinhadas aos processos e procedimentos de validação da TotalEnergies.
  • Trabalhar em coordenação com a equipe do ativo, líderes de equipe, sede e integradores seniores de geociências.
  • Representar a TotalEnergies no Comitê Técnico em assuntos de Geologia de Reservatórios.
  • Contribuir com o retorno técnico sobre dados de campo, comportamento, metodologias e ferramentas.

Formação : Bacharelado em Geologia ou disciplinas/especialidades relacionadas.

Experiência Profissional : De 5 a 10 anos.

Habilidades Interpessoais : Boas habilidades de apresentação e comunicação. Confortável em ambiente intercultural.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Consultor(a) SAP SD Senior - RJ
description:
Você na Deloitte!

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando como Consultor(a) SAP SD no time de SAP , que busca implantar/integrar o sistema . Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Atuar com localização BR;
  • Implementar o sistema do zero como ponto focal;
  • Ter contato com reforma tributária.

Na Deloitte, buscamos pessoas que queiram gerar impactos positivos todos os dias. Impulsionamos talentos para que possam se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo, com times diversos e que tragam energia, empoderamento, interação e conexões. O nosso crescimento é exponencial porque os talentos que recrutamos possuem os nossos valores em suas essências.

Liderar o caminho, fomentar a inclusão, colaborar para mensurar impactos, servir com integridade e cuidar uns dos outros são pontos essenciais e inegociáveis para fortalecer ainda mais o nosso propósito.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto .

  • Inglês fluente;
  • Ampla experiência com localização BR;
  • Conhecimento na reforma tributária.

Beneficios

O que estará disponível para você?

Desenvolvimento Profisional

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com Universidade Corporativa, acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano de carreira estruturado, com mentoria de profissionais da Deloitte por meio de um(a) coach, que poderá ouvir seus desafios e apoiar para que consiga evoluir tanto com habilidades técnicas, quanto com habilidades comportamentais com base na própria experiência. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

title: Analista comercial
description:
Sobre a Lobie

A Lobie é a proptech que está revolucionando a gestão de imóveis para investidores. Nascemos de um grupo com mais de 80 anos de história e expertise no mercado imobiliário, combinando a solidez de uma das maiores construtoras do país com a capilaridade de uma administradora líder em gestão de condomínios.

Nossa missão é maximizar a rentabilidade de propriedades localizadas em pontos estratégicos através da locação de curto prazo (Short-Term Rental). Fazemos isso sob o lema

"Low Cost, High Yield" , garantindo uma gestão completa, transparente e altamente eficiente, com uma taxa de ocupação média superior a 85% em nossas mais de 750 unidades contratadas.

A Oportunidade: Analista Comercial Jr. (Last Mile)

Você já se perguntou o que acontece depois que um investidor compra um apartamento na planta? É aí que você entra.

Estamos buscando um(a) Analista Comercial Jr. (Last Mile) para ser a ponte essencial entre a aquisição do imóvel pelo investidor e o início da sua jornada de rentabilidade conosco. Esta não é uma venda tradicional; é o início de um relacionamento de longo prazo. Você será o rosto da Lobie no momento mais crucial: a ativação do ativo do nosso cliente.

Seu papel será garantir que cada investidor que adquire uma unidade em projetos parceiros entenda e adira aos nossos serviços de gestão e decoração, transformando um apartamento vazio em uma máquina de gerar receita.

Seus Desafios Serão:
  • Ativar a carteira de investidores que compram unidades nos empreendimentos parceiros, realizando o primeiro contato pós-compra.
  • Apresentar a tese de investimento da Lobie, demonstrando o potencial de rentabilidade através da nossa gestão especializada em locação de curta temporada.
  • Conduzir a venda do nosso produto
  • Lobie Decor , uma solução completa que inclui projeto de arquitetura, compra de itens com custo reduzido pela escala e gestão total da implementação, deixando a unidade pronta para operar.
  • Construir e nutrir um relacionamento de confiança com os investidores, garantindo uma experiência de onboarding fluida e positiva.
  • Realizar a gestão do funil de vendas e atividades no CRM, assegurando o acompanhamento de todos os leads.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes de Operações e Marketing para garantir a passagem de bastão perfeita após a contratação dos serviços.
O que Buscamos em Você:
  • Paixão por pessoas e pela construção de relacionamentos duradouros.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade para gerenciar o "último metro" do processo comercial.
  • Vivência na área comercial ou de relacionamento com o cliente, preferencialmente B2C.
  • Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Interesse pelo mercado imobiliário, de investimentos e/ou design de interiores é um grande diferencial.
Por que se Juntar à Lobie?
  • Impacto Real: Você verá o resultado direto do seu trabalho na receita da companhia e na satisfação dos nossos clientes.
  • Crescimento Acelerado: Faça parte de uma proptech em plena expansão, com o suporte de um dos grupos mais sólidos do setor imobiliário brasileiro.
  • Cultura de Inovação: Trabalhe em um ambiente que combina tecnologia, dados e uma abordagem moderna para um mercado tradicional.
  • Desenvolvimento: Oportunidade de aprender sobre investimentos, mercado imobiliário e vendas consultivas de alto valor.

Se você é uma pessoa comunicativa, organizada e movida pelo desafio de transformar um negócio em um relacionamento de sucesso, queremos te conhecer!

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

What do we offer?

Contract wise:

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)

Onboarding & benefits:

· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.

· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.

· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.

· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.

description:
Digital Construction Coordinator - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

Who we are!

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments

Ready to elevate your career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV in English)

title: Digital Construction Engineer
description:
Digital Construction Engineer - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Engineer, you will be responsible for driving and supporting the implementation of information management processes using Building Information Modelling (BIM) across the lifecycle of a construction project. You will serve as a key liaison between the project management team and external stakeholders (consultants, subcontractors, and clients), ensuring digital deliverables and information workflows align with project and client requirements. While your core focus will be on BIM and data coordination, your scope may also include supporting digital construction technologies such as 3D scanning, drones, field data capture, and robotics. You will play an active role in embedding digital best practices and contributing to the project's digital strategy from planning through handover.

Your Role:

  • Support development and communication of BIM and information requirements.
  • Assist in preparing and maintaining project documentation (BEP, MIDP, EIR, LAP, etc.).
  • Configure and maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows in EDMS platforms.
  • Set up BIM workflows and coordinate 3D models, identifying and resolving clashes.
  • Provide BIM training and guidance to internal departments.
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models for internal teams and subcontractors.
  • Support digital tendering efforts and contribute to project-level digital reporting.
  • Represent BIM in project coordination and progress meetings.
  • Collaborate on the development of standards, templates, and digital procedures.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and BS 1192.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring tools (e.g., Revit, Tekla, Archicad).
  • Experience in BIM coordination tools (e.g., Navisworks, Revizto).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie) and model checking (e.g., Solibri).
  • Knowledge of CDE platforms (Aconex, BIM 360) and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera).
  • Visual programming (Dynamo) and Power BI experience preferred.
  • Understanding of 4D/5D BIM workflows and outputs.
  • Strong communicator with collaborative mindset.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive.
  • Resilient under pressure with strong time management.
  • Passionate about digital innovation in construction.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

title: Offshore Cargo Supervisor
description:
We are looking for an Offshore Cargo Supervisor for one of our clients in O&G, in an offshore position (14 X 14).

This is a TEMPORARY POSITION, for a 6 ~ 9 months (renewable) project.

Offshore Cargo Supervisor: What will your responsibilities and missions be?

Responsible for supervising, monitoring, and participating in all marine-related activities, such as offloading operations, transshipment with support vessels, cargo handling and cleaning, ballasting operations, tank washing (COW), equipment maintenance, diving operations, and pull-in/pull-out operations. All these activities must be carried out with a focus on safety and in compliance with internal and external procedures and regulations, always in support of the Marine Superintendent and under his authority. He is also jointly responsible for ensuring the readiness and availability of the offshore facility's rescue equipment.

What Profile and Skills are Required for this Cargo Supervisor Position?

  • Nationality: Brazilian Only
  • Local of work: Offshore – onboard FPSOs (boarding points: Jacarepaguá, Macaé, Farol de São Tomé, Cabo Frio, Maricá)
  • English: Intermediate to Advanced

Graduation/Certificate:

  • Minimum: Marine or technical background — e.g., Marinheiro de Convés, CB, Mestre de Cabotagem or equivalent maritime certification.
  • Required Certifications (valid at embark): CBSP, CACI, CESS, MCIA, NR-33 (Confined Space), NR-35 (Work at Heights), H2S Awareness, Benzeno Awareness, GASD, ECOW (modules 1 to 4)
  • Search parameters: COW AND Ballast Operations AND Diving Support AND Lifesaving Equipment AND Offshore Cargo Handling

Experience:

  • Proven experience in offshore cargo operations, marine logistics, ballast management, and tank cleaning procedures
  • Experience coordinating diving support and marine safety inspections
  • Availability for temporary offshore rotation (14x14)

Are you interested in this position? Send us your application!

EP2C Energy’s Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At EP2C Energy, we are committed to fostering diversity and inclusion. We strongly encourage applications from individuals recognized as disabled workers.

Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) Policy

We prioritize adherence to HSE regulations to ensure a safe and sustainable working environment for our employees. Our goal is to make a positive impact on the environment.

By joining our team, you will be expected to follow HSE procedures and best practices while contributing to the continuous improvement of our processes.

Who Are We? – EP2C Energy

Founded in 2014, EP2C Energy is a fast-growing technical assistance company specializing in:

  • Energy (Renewable Energies, Oil & Gas, Nuclear)
  • Life Sciences (Pharmaceutical, Cosmetics, Food Industries)
  • Large-Scale Industrial Projects (Mining, Construction, Water Treatment, Petrochemicals, and Chemical Industries)

With an international presence — including subsidiaries in Latin America, Africa, and Asia — we collaborate with major industry players and offer exciting career growth opportunities in France and worldwide.

At EP2C Energy , we value our employees’ expertise and are committed to their professional and personal development.

Joining EP2C Energy means becoming part of a dynamic team and an ambitious mission!

title: Section Manager
description:

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a Section Manager, you’ll play a vital role in the successful execution of MEP works across complex data center projects. You’ll lead field productivity, manage change effectively, and ensure technical excellence in every phase.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

About Your Team

You’ll report directly to the Construction Manager, with indirect reporting to the Project Manager, and will lead a team of Site Engineers and Foremen. The section management team ensures quality, safety, productivity, and coordination across MEP disciplines, collaborating closely with planning, QA/QC, procurement, and subcontractors to ensure seamless execution across project zones and disciplines.

Your Role

As a Section Manager, you will:

  • Issue daily/weekly installation plans and report progress.
  • Enforce method statements, risk assessments, and DSTI schedules.
  • Track material deliveries in coordination with Project Engineers.
  • Manage change and drawing/spec distribution.
  • Monitor tools, consumables, KPIs, and labour productivity.
  • Ensure HSE and QA/QC compliance at all times.
  • Work week: Monday to Saturday (standard for project-based roles in the region)

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years’ experience in MEP construction or infrastructure
  • Strong knowledge of installation sequencing, QA/QC, and HSE
  • Site leadership and technical documentation experience
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills

What We Offer

  • Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.
  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.
  • A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Estágio em Engenharia de processos
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Principais atividades:

  • Auxiliar na avaliação de documentos técnicos dentro do escopo de processos de tratamento de água e esgoto junto ao gestor;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento de planilhas de cálculo, documentos, relatórios ou apresentações;
  • Apoiar em pesquisas em artigos técnicos e literatura especializada.

Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Química ou similares;
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office;
  • Perfil com flexibilidade, alta curiosidade e desejo de aprender;
  • Disponibilidade para modelo híbrido (2 dias presenciais por semana);
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.

Benefícios

  • Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
  • Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Gympass;
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Kit office.

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Deputy Operations Manager
description:
Deputy Operations Manager

Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

GDIT/CSRA is seeking a self-motivated, independent working Deputy Operations Managers to provide Operations support at various data collection facilities throughout Brazil.

Experience in managing a team of people (people management), labor, Information Technology, facilities, and subcontractors are a must.

*Applicants must be fluent in English and Portuguese.

Must be able to pass security background investigations, but do not have to be US citizens.

Essential Job Functions

  • The Deputy is responsible for assisting the OFC manager on the day-to-day operations of the Off-site Facilitation Center (CASV). He/She must ensure that the OFC operations comply with all requirements of the contract and satisfies all expectations of the supported US Post.
  • The Deputy Operations Manager reports to the Operations Manager.
  • The Deputy Operations Manager primary responsibility is to assist the Manager in supervising the entire OFC operations and assure the accurate and timely processing of biometric related data and documents.
  • Main responsibilities: Assist the Operations Manager in the following activities:
  • Ensure that the OFC operates effectively, providing quality service to all Visa applicants while maintaining compliance with the provisions of the contract, CSRA policies and procedures and governing laws of host country.
  • Implement the visa application processes to insure all applications are processed accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Provide accurate reports according to predetermined schedules. These include, but not limited to: Monthly templates/reports for various Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Monthly status reports, and other ad-hoc reports as may be required by the client, the Post and/or CSRA.
  • Recruit, train, and manage staff to support OFC operations. Address performance issues and develop/implement corrective actions.
  • Manage all facility-related matters to include physical and personnel security.
  • Manage labor, facility and expense budgets as provided by and under the direction of the CSRA Operations Manager, and budget estimates, as requested.
  • Manage the Information Technology (IT) operations and ensure that all equipment are operated and maintained properly.
  • The Deputy Operations Manager will represent the Operations Manager when he/she is on vacation and or leave.
  • Day-to-day duties include, but not limited to: he/she attends meetings with the Post and CSRA Task Order Manager to discuss service levels.
  • He/she manages the OFC budget, coordinates with and manages suppliers and/or subcontractors who are supplying services to the OFC, i.e. courier service, bank institutions, building maintenance crew, etc.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Supervisory & People Management (Team Management) / Facility Management / Vendor Management experience.
  • Must be fluent in English (speak, read, write) and Portuguese.
  • Must be able to pass security background investigations, but do not have to be US citizens.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong human relations skills to select, develop, mentor, discipline and reward employees.
  • Challenges others to develop as leaders while serving as a role model and mentor.
  • Strong interpersonal and presentation skills for interacting with team members and clients.
  • Strong organization and time management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a team environment
  • Is results oriented and customer focused.
  • Identifies opportunities for improvement and makes constructive suggestions for change.

title: BIM Modeler - Civil
description:
Civil BIM Modeler - Design | UAE

Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Holdings L.L.C - S.O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Civil BIM Modeler , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.

Your Role

  • Review Tender & IFC BIM models, 2D drawings, and asset data issued by consultants in line with ISO19650 standards.
  • Lead BIM modeling for design documents; guide and mentor a team of modelers.
  • Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.
  • Maintain and optimize BIM models following best industry practices to ensure healthy, coordinated models.
  • Coordinate with BIM and design teams to support modeling from 2D CAD plans and construction documents.
  • Conduct clash detection and support clash avoidance measures.
  • Assist internal and external stakeholders with the development and updating of construction documents.
  • Maintain and apply company/project BIM standards, templates, and content.
  • Update models and drawings based on RFI responses, engineering instructions, and design changes.
  • Identify discrepancies in contract documents and report them promptly.
  • Ensure all work complies with project information standards, BIM Execution Plans, and ALEC BIM implementation standards.
  • Support as-built/redline and handover processes by updating models and extracting accurate drawings.
  • Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.
  • Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.

What We’re Looking For

  • Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years).
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience as a BIM Modeler in GCC countries.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Revit and AutoCAD .
  • Advanced knowledge of BIM fundamentals, principles, and workflows.
  • Experience working in a collaborative shared environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency with Navisworks and/or Revizto .
  • Advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Acrobat.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.

Ready to plan the path to project success?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.

Apply today and be part of something excellent!

Kindly upload your CV in English.

Sobre a ZEISS:

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

Sobre a nossa Divisão Médica:

Oferecemos soluções completas para diagnósticos e tratamentos oftalmológicos, além da avançada tecnologia de radioterapia intraoperatória e soluções de visualização inovadoras para neurocirurgia, odontologia, entre outros. Nosso portfólio possui promissoras tecnologias do futuro que garante aos seus parceiros e clientes confiança e excelência.

Sobre a nossa vaga de Representante Comercial | PJ/Parceria/Canal de Vendas | Divisão de Odontologia (atuação em Rio de Janeiro e Região)

Estamos em busca de Representantes Comerciais apaixonados por inovação e excelência no atendimento ao cliente para se juntarem à nossa equipe na divisão de Odontologia.

Como representante da marca ZEISS, você será responsável por:

- Prospecção Ativa: Identificar e engajar novos clientes, expandindo nossa presença no mercado odontológico.

- Demonstração de Produtos: Apresentar as características e benefícios das nossas Lupas de Magnificação e Microscópios Cirúrgicos.

- Relacionamento com o Cliente: Realizar visitas de pós-venda para garantir a satisfação e fidelização, além de identificar novas oportunidades de negócio.

- Educação Continuada: Participar ativamente de cursos, congressos e eventos, mantendo-se atualizado sobre as tendências do setor.

Requisitos:

title: Principal Pipeline Drafter 25002281
description:
Company Overview:

People power our future. That is why advancing a dynamic, inclusive environment, where everyone grows and thrives is critically important to us. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing offshore platforms hundreds of miles from shore, and using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure.

For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. Here, what you do matters.

Job Overview:

The Principal Pipeline Drafter directly impacts the effectiveness of their team and related team. They exchange ideas and information relating to Pipeline Drafting effectively. The Principal Pipeline Drafter may work autonomously within established Pipeline Drafting procedures and practices. They act as a lead, coordinating the work of others. The Principal Pipeline Drafter proposes improvements to processes and methods within the Pipeline Drafting discipline.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with project teams to develop and refine detailed piping system designs, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications
  • Prepare accurate and comprehensive 2D and 3D pipeline drawings, layouts, and schematics using computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) software
  • Review and interpret project drawings, specifications, and engineering deliverables to accurately capture project requirements and constraints
  • Coordinate with other disciplines such as process, mechanical, and structural engineering to integrate pipeline designs seamlessly into the overall project layout
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior draftsmen to ensure high-quality and timely deliverables
  • Conduct interdisciplinary clash detection reviews to identify and mitigate clashes or conflicts among various piping systems, equipment, and structures
  • Assist in the preparation of material take-offs, bills of quantity (BOQ), and requisitions to support procurement activities
  • Continuously improve pipeline design processes and standards, staying updated with the latest industry practices, advancements, and technological tools
  • Collaboratively work with project managers and engineers to effectively communicate design progress, and challenges, and ensure timely completion of deliverables
  • Participate in design reviews, constructability assessments, and HAZOP studies to provide valuable insights and contributions to the project team
  • Implement Prefabrication, Erection methods, and DC reports information into shop drawing
  • Implement design change in the shop drawing based on approved SQ, TQ, SI and ARN
  • Identify non-original scope using Change Management System

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • High School diploma or higher with a focus in Mechanical Engineering, Pipeline Engineering, or related field
  • Minimum of 8 years of Pipeline Drafter experience in the Oil & Gas Construction Industry, with a focus on pipelines, and demonstrates a strong understanding of pipeline design principles and practices.
  • Proficiency in using CAD software, such as AutoCAD, Navisworks, PDS, PDMS, Bently Microstation, or similar tools, for creating pipeline/piping designs and drawings
  • Familiarity with different pipeline materials, fittings, and supports, and their respective installation methods and constraints
  • Strong understanding of pipeline/piping design concepts, including isometric, orthographic, and schematic drawings
  • Deep knowledge of industry-specific codes and standards like ASME B31.3, ASME B31.4, API 570, API 1104 and ASME Sections VIII & IX
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy and quality in drawing creation and review processes
  • Strong understanding of interdisciplinary coordination and interface management among various engineering disciplines
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders
  • Flexible and adaptable mindset to thrive in a dynamic and challenging work environment

title: Coordenador(a) de Qualidade
description:
Cox é uma utility global de água e energia verticalmente integrada, na vanguarda da solução dos maiores desafios da transição verde. Com mais de 6.000 funcionários espalhados por 30 países, Cox é construída com base no compromisso de uma equipe dedicada à sustentabilidade e ao progresso de longo prazo.

Buscamos Coordenador(a) de Qualidade para atuar na Divisão de Construção, coordenando time e atividades de todos ao projetos em nível Brasil.

Responsabilidades

  • Coordenar a implantação do Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade nas obras, alinhado as diretrizes corporativas.
  • Elaborar, implementar e revisar o Plano da Qualidade das obras, em conformidade com normas técnicas, requisitos do cliente e diretrizes corporativas.
  • Participar e acompanhar auditorias internas e externas.
  • Planejar e coordenar as atividades relacionadas ao controle da qualidade, como inspeções, ensaios e testes de qualidade nos processos construtivos (fundações, montagem de torres, lançamento de cabos, etc.).
  • Garantir a rastreabilidade dos materiais e serviços utilizados, por meio da análise de certificados, ensaios e registros de inspeção.
  • Acompanhar e controlar indicadores de desempenho da qualidade
  • Identificar, investigar e gerenciar não conformidades, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas
  • Promover a cultura da qualidade e da melhoria contínua nos projetos de construção.
  • Dar seguimento ao sistema de requisitos legais, normativos e contratuais relacionados à qualidade.
  • Promover treinamentos e capacitações para a equipe sobre normas e procedimentos de qualidade.
  • Prestar suporte contínuo à área de execução na interpretação e aplicação dos procedimentos de qualidade, assegurando que as atividades em campo estejam alinhadas aos requisitos técnicos, normativos e corporativos.

Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento técnico em projetos de execução de obras de transmissão de energia elétrica
  • Domínio das normas aplicáveis: ABNT NBR ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001.
  • Habilidade em liderança de equipes de qualidade.
  • Capacidade analítica e tomada de decisão com foco em melhoria contínua
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de qualidade, gestão de processos e indicadores
  • Pacote Office avançado
  • Desejável conhecimento na Metodologia BIM

Formação :

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia.
  • MBA ou Pós-graduação em temas relacionados a Qualidade
  • Especialização ou certificações em Qualidade (ISO 9001, Six Sigma, Lean, etc.)

Experiência :

  • Experiência prévia em posições de liderança na área de qualidade, preferencialmente nos setores de linhas de transmissão/ energia
  • Atuação como auditor interno e acompanhamento de auditorias externas.

-Dentre os princípios que integram o código de ética da Cox, se encontra como valor fundamental a diversidade e igualdade de oportunidades. Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas à PCD.

-Informamos que a Cox cumpre com o disposto na Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados – LGPD, e ao aceitar participar deste processo de seleção e ao enviar seus dados pessoais e sensíveis, será considerado sua ciência e concordância para o tratamento dos mesmos de acordo com a referida lei.

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:

title: Site Engineer - MEP
description:
MEP Site Engineer - UAE

Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.

Why Join Us?

As a Site Engineer - MEP, you’ll be instrumental in delivering world-class mechanical, electrical, and plumbing works across dynamic construction environments. You’ll manage daily site operations, uphold quality and safety standards, and ensure technical integrity from planning through execution.

At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.

Your Role

  • Leading the execution of all MEP installations across designated zones of the project.
  • Translating blueprints into efficient field execution using Time & Motion analysis.
  • Monitoring cost versus allowable outputs and reporting effectively to line managers.
  • Ensuring QA/QC requirements are met — we aim for zero repeat works and flawless delivery.
  • Coordinating with Supervisors, Foremen, and QA/QC Engineers to roll out method statements and risk assessments in line with company and consultant standards.
  • Keeping schedules tight by ensuring timely availability of materials and tools.
  • Managing site documentation: marked-up drawings, progress updates, RFI registers, and more.
  • Escalating key issues that need senior intervention while maintaining control of daily site priorities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent).

  • Minimum 7 years hands-on site experience in MEP works.
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera & Microsoft Office Suite .

Ready to Lead?

If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.

Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

  • Garantir que os investimentos e despesas da área estejam aderentes ao budget anual, monitorando variações, evitando estouros e propondo realocações estratégicas quando necessário.

  • Buscar constantemente formas de reduzir retrabalho, integrar sistemas (ERP, BI, etc.) e melhorar a previsibilidade e rastreabilidade de informações e custos.

  • Pacote Office avançado.

  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

QUEM SOMOS

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. title: General Foreman
description:
General Foreman - Civil | UAE

Are you a hands-on construction leader with deep structural experience and a drive for delivering high-quality work on time, every time?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a General Foreman , you’ll lead multiple structural work zones, from formwork and concrete to steel and blockwork. You’ll manage a team of Senior Foremen, ensuring all structural activities are planned, resourced, executed, and handed over to the highest technical and safety standards. Your role is critical to coordinating construction efforts, maintaining productivity, and upholding ALEC’s commitment to quality and environmental compliance.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Section Manager and lead teams of Senior Foremen, Foremen, and labour across various structural disciplines. You’ll work closely with planning, procurement, safety, and QA/QC teams to ensure seamless execution across all phases of work.

Your Role

As a General Foreman, you will:

  • Lead and support Foremen in managing labour and tradesmen across all structural work fronts.
  • Interpret structural drawings and ensure accurate site setup and execution.
  • Plan resources effectively and manage site access, logistics, and emergency readiness.
  • Ensure the timely procurement and correct usage of construction materials and plant.
  • Enforce ALEC’s safety policies, ensuring work is carried out using the proper PPE and safety procedures.
  • Manage heavy equipment and ensure only qualified operators handle machinery.
  • Coordinate across structural teams including carpentry, steel, rebar, blockwork, and concrete.
  • Drive productivity initiatives, ensuring teams work at optimal efficiency.
  • Lead by example, coach site teams, and identify upskilling needs for unskilled labour.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards, carry out quality audits, and implement corrective actions.
  • Support environmental management before, during, and after construction phases.
  • Oversee the structural handover process with complete documentation and quality verification.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience : 10+ years in construction with at least 2 years as a Senior Foreman, specifically in structural works.
  • Certifications : First Aider qualification is required.
  • Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of structural works including formwork, blockwork, rebar, and carpentry.

description:

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

The Digital Construction Manager leads and oversees BIM-based information management on a project, acting as the main point of contact between the project team and external stakeholders (client, consultants, subcontractors). While their focus is on BIM, the role may extend to other digital construction tools like scanning, drones, and robotics.

Your Role:

  • Manage client expectations for BIM and ensure deliverables meet requirements.
  • Develop and maintain information management resources (BIM Execution Plan, EIRs, MIDP, etc.).
  • Set up BIM workflows and manage the project's CDE (Common Data Environment).
  • Lead 3D coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting.
  • Train and support project teams on BIM processes and tools.
  • Ensure QA/QC of BIM models and deliverables.
  • Report on BIM compliance and progress at the project level.
  • Contribute to tender activities and support process development.

What We're looking For

  • Strong knowledge of ISO 19650 and PAS 1192 standards.
  • Proficient in BIM tools (e.g., Revit , Tekla , Navisworks , Revizto , etc.).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie).
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., BIM 360, Aconex).
  • Skills in automation , data validation , and tools like Solibri , Dynamo , and Power BI .
  • Knowledge of 4D/5D modeling and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera P6).
  • Strong communicator and team player.
  • Confident, resilient, and organized.
  • Detail-oriented with strong time and pressure management.
  • Passionate about BIM and digital transformation.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

title: Pessoa Analista de Controladoria SR
description:
Através de um portfólio completo com foco na descarbonização de infraestruturas de energia, a ENGIE oferece soluções integradas capazes de transformar cidades e empresas para que façam o melhor uso da energia baseadas em dois pilares: redução de custos e de emissões de CO2. Para cidades, desenvolvemos projetos de Iluminação Pública e Mobilidade Elétrica tornando-as mais eficientes e colaborando na construção de uma sociedade mais sustentável e eficiente.
