title: Exploration Geology Projects Manager – Industrial & New-Material Commodities (The Middle East)
description:
The Company

Globe 24-7 in partnership with a key client in Saudi Arabia are working together to source experienced and qualified talent for their mineral extraction operation.


The Role

The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing and managing a team of geologists, contributing to the advanced-stage exploration of Industrial Minerals (IM) and New Materials (NM). The focus is on delivering resources in core commodities and supporting the Exploration & Resource Development (ERD) strategy. This role plays a key part in advancing the corporate Strategy 2040 by targeting areas with the highest geological potential. The position reports to the Director of Generative Exploration.


The Responsibilities

  • Support the identification, testing, and delineation of targets across advanced-stage Industrial Minerals (IM) and New Materials (NM) commodities.
  • Develop and implement strategic exploration plans for advanced-stage IM & NM, including target prioritization and cost management.
  • Direct the identification and evaluation of new IM & NM deposits with potential for economic or industrial development.
  • Lead the preparation of exploration operations plans, budgets, and justifications; monitor expenditure to ensure adherence and prevent over- or underspending.
  • Track and assess key performance indicators (KPIs) for advanced-stage IM & NM exploration (e.g., drill targets, new resources).
  • Oversee and manage geological research activities within your team; act as a subject matter expert in geology.
  • Prepare and deliver accurate, timely exploration reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Design and manage exploration programs and site investigations to identify deposits viable for future economic extraction.
  • Foster a "Safety First" culture and ensure full implementation of the Environment, Health, Safety, and Security (EHSS) management system across the exploration team.
  • Champion innovation through automation, digitalization, artificial intelligence, and data analytics to optimize exploration operations.


The Requirements

  • Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in a relevant Geoscience discipline from an accredited institution; PhD preferred
  • Minimum of 15 years’ experience in geology within the mining industry, including 10–15 years in mineral exploration and development with a strong emphasis on greenfield targeting and grassroots exploration
  • At least 3 years in a management or leadership role, overseeing exploration teams and projects
  • Proven multi-commodity and multi-jurisdiction exploration background, with demonstrated expertise in copper, nickel, zinc, lithium, silver, gold, and rare earth element (REE) systems, particularly within Archean crustal environments
  • Strong understanding of mineral deposit geology, mineral systems, and the challenges of discovery under cover
  • Hands-on experience across at least two major exploration terrains or belts, and deep technical knowledge of at least two commodities, with working knowledge of at least two others or advanced understanding of specific exploration processes
  • Direct experience with multiple mineralization styles, including porphyry copper-gold and magmatic nickel-copper systems
  • Proficient in a full range of exploration methods and capable of selecting the most effective techniques based on project needs and context
  • Significant exposure to known deposits through extensive field visits or mine site secondments
  • Strong commitment to maintaining and promoting high safety standards in field operations
  • Highly skilled in field analysis, mapping, sampling, geological documentation, reporting, and mentoring of junior geoscientists
  • Demonstrated experience in identifying and interpreting geoscientific and geophysical datasets across multiple scales
  • Strong project management capabilities, including strategic planning, budgeting, work planning, and team coordination


The Rewards

  • The position offers a competitive remuneration package. Lodgings are modern and secure.
  • FIFO roster


Contact Us

Please apply directly by submitting your resume, preferably as a Microsoft Word document.

title: Consultant
description:
This role can be in Sao Paulo or Rio.


Heidrick Consulting Brazil

You would be part of our Consulting Practice in Brazil. At Heidrick Consulting, we work with Senior Leadership, Executive Teams, and Boards, covering major national and multi-national companies across all industry sectors in Brazil and Latin America.

You will be joining a growing, dynamic team, and in this role as an Engagement Leader, you will expand and deepen your consulting skills by leading various projects as well as managing junior team members. Your contributions will expose you to senior leaders across a variety of industries and geographies.


Primary Responsibilities

The main purpose of the Consultant is to develop consulting solutions as part of client engagements, to write proposals and support business development activities, to act as engagement manager on specific projects and to support Principals and Partners in their delivery.


You will begin to lead, manage, and own problem-solving efforts on a large portion of a client engagement or to lead on smaller engagements. Specifically, you will be responsible for identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analysis, and then synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. Throughout an engagement, you will be involved in discussions and presentations with senior client leadership.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Gathering, analyzing and interpreting data and information; generating insights from analyses.
  • Preparing and presenting information and insights in an impactful and compelling way to help drive client insights and engagement delivery.
  • Delivering a range of consulting solutions, preparing reports and other deliverables that meet client needs.
  • Facilitating and working with client teams with a client first mindset, managing and designing client sessions.
  • Ensuring work is “client ready” (e.g., error free, aligned with expectations, ready to be shared with client) and actively managing expectations with the team.
  • Planning and prioritizing work ensuring team deadlines and quality standards are met.
  • Contributing to proposals (e.g., supporting content development of project design and approaches and case studies) and mobilizing ‘won’ initiatives.
  • Building and sharing reusable, client ready materials, insights (including case studies) and project learnings.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.
  • Contributing to thought leadership and supporting the development of product, tools, and methodologies.
  • Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.


The Ideal Candidate:


Passionate and Engaged: Will bring a genuine enthusiasm for serving a broad variety of organizations on strategic people and talent topics, including leadership and team development, succession planning, Board effectiveness and organizational culture change.

Self-Driven and Inquisitive: Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.

Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player: Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.


Minimum Role Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of professional work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a management, strategy or leadership consulting environment.
  • An undergraduate degree is required.
  • Experience working directly with clients in a professional service, team-based environment.
  • Ability to drive workload independently within a broader team project setting.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, being comfortable with handling multiple priorities and being able to adapt to changing business needs.
  • Demonstrated advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word; easily able to adopt new technologies and software.
  • Excellent communication skills; writing skills with a proven track record of success preparing concise and compelling reports and other client ready deliverables.
  • Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese. Other languages are a plus.
  • Willingness to travel locally and globally as required.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar soluções de infraestrutura Linux on-premises para sistemas de missão crítica.

  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura na melhoria contínua e confiabilidade dos ambientes.

  • Virtualização (VMware ou similares), alta disponibilidade e clusters.
  • Dockerização de aplicações (APIs Java, Angular, mensageria).
  • Automação de infraestrutura (Ansible, Terraform, Shell/Python), pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins).
  • Redes avançadas: IP, subnetting, roteamento, VLANs, VPNs, NAT, ACLs, DNS, troubleshooting e integração com Cisco.
  • Load balancing e escalabilidade (NGINX ou similares).
  • Mensageria corporativa (RabbitMQ, Kafka).

  • Integração e suporte a APIs Java, Angular e Camunda BPM.

  • Segurança de infraestrutura (hardening, firewalls, controle de acesso, segregação de ambientes).

  • Versionamento e IaC com Git e Terraform.

title: Team Leader
description:
Position Overview – Team Leader


  • Location: Rio de Janeiro
  • Company: Confidential
  • Industry: Offshore Engineering


We are currently seeking a dynamic and experienced Service Team Leader to join our esteemed team. The ideal candidate should hold a Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Hydraulic, Control, Electrical, or Naval) or a Naval Engineer diploma, with at least 8 years of relevant experience. Advanced or fluent English proficiency is required, along with strong leadership skills.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage a team of service technicians to ensure efficient and effective service delivery.
  • Supervise complex service tasks and projects, ensuring compliance with quality standards and safety protocols.
  • Act as a liaison between the service team and management, providing updates and regular reports.


Required Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Naval Engineering.
  • Minimum of 8 years of experience in a similar position.
  • Advanced or fluent English proficiency.
  • Willingness to travel locally and internationally for service assignments.
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel).
  • Proficiency in reading and understanding mechanical, hydraulic and electrical diagrams, as well as mechanical drawings.
  • Profiency in dealing with field signals (4-20mA, 0-10V, Hart, relay outputs, PT-100) and industrial network protocols.
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD and 3D programs
  • Familiarity with electrical circuits, electric panels, Variable Frequency Drives (VFD), and ATEX standards.
  • Familiarity with SCADA systems, Electric Motors, Motors, Heat Exchangers, Hydraulic Cylinders, Hydraulic and Safety Valves, Load Cell Functionality/Calibration, Pressure and Temperature Sensor Functionality/Calibration, Piston Pumps with Fixed and Variable Displacement, Hydraulic Motors with Fixed or Variable Displacement, Electric Motors
  • Familiarity of Siemens PLCs (S7-300/S7-1500) and industrial network protocols.
  • Knowledge about Drum Winches, Chain Tensioning Systems, and Crane Functionalities.


Key Attributes:

  • Problem-solving and critical thinking : Quickly analyze issues, anticipate potential challenges, and implement effective solutions to maintain operational efficiency.
  • Proactive approach: Take initiative to improve processes, identify growth opportunities, and contribute to the company's expansion rather than just executing tasks.
  • Stakeholder communication: Clearly convey technical and strategic updates to diverse stakeholders, ensuring alignment and understanding.
  • Team leadership and development: Guide, mentor, and support team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and accountability.
  • Adaptability and resilience: Thrive in a dynamic environment, adjusting to changing priorities while maintaining high performance under pressure.
  • Ownership and accountability: Fully own tasks and deliverables, ensuring high-quality outcomes and adherence to company goals.
  • Strategic mindset: Actively contribute to Company’s growth, not just as an executor but as a proactive force driving the company’s success.
  • Role awareness and responsibility: Operate with a clear understanding of role boundaries, knowing what to manage independently, what requires escalation, and who to report to for critical decisions.


About the Company:

With more than three decades of expertise in the offshore sector, we bring a comprehensive and versatile approach to engineering. Our commitment to innovative solutions and determination to overcome complex challenges have positioned us as a trusted partner in significant offshore projects across the globe. Driven by a spirit of exploration, we are also expanding into groundbreaking initiatives within the renewable energy industry.

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor de Integração que irá atuar como responsável técnico pela camada de integração entre os sistemas SAP (ERP S/4HANA e IS-U HANA) e os sistemas legados da Light, aplicando práticas de DevSecOps para garantir entregas seguras, escaláveis, automatizadas e de alta disponibilidade. O profissional será peça-chave na sustentação de pipelines, automação de deploys, governança de APIs e segurança das integrações, assegurando performance e integridade dos fluxos críticos de dados.

Traga a sua energia para a Light !


Seus desafios serão:


  • Projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de integração entre o SAP (ERP e IS-U HANA) e sistemas legados, utilizando ferramentas modernas de automação e orquestração.

O que é necessário você ter:


  • Ensino superior completo em áreas de TI.

title: Supervisor de vendas
description:

A FVO Alimentos é uma empresa com mais de 50 anos de história no mercado, referência na fabricação e distribuição de alimentos para animais.   • Proatividade e foco em resultados.

  • Organização e habilidade em planejamento.

title: Exploration Geology Projects Manager – Industrial & New-Material Commodities (The Middle East)
description:
The Company

Globe 24-7 in partnership with a key client in Saudi Arabia are working together to source experienced and qualified talent for their mineral extraction operation.

The Role

The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing and managing a team of geologists, contributing to the advanced-stage exploration of Industrial Minerals (IM) and New Materials (NM). The focus is on delivering resources in core commodities and supporting the Exploration & Resource Development (ERD) strategy. This role plays a key part in advancing the corporate Strategy 2040 by targeting areas with the highest geological potential. The position reports to the Director of Generative Exploration.

The Responsibilities

  • Support the identification, testing, and delineation of targets across advanced-stage Industrial Minerals (IM) and New Materials (NM) commodities.
  • Develop and implement strategic exploration plans for advanced-stage IM & NM, including target prioritization and cost management.
  • Direct the identification and evaluation of new IM & NM deposits with potential for economic or industrial development.
  • Lead the preparation of exploration operations plans, budgets, and justifications; monitor expenditure to ensure adherence and prevent over- or underspending.
  • Track and assess key performance indicators (KPIs) for advanced-stage IM & NM exploration (e.g., drill targets, new resources).
  • Oversee and manage geological research activities within your team; act as a subject matter expert in geology.
  • Prepare and deliver accurate, timely exploration reports for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Design and manage exploration programs and site investigations to identify deposits viable for future economic extraction.
  • Foster a "Safety First" culture and ensure full implementation of the Environment, Health, Safety, and Security (EHSS) management system across the exploration team.
  • Champion innovation through automation, digitalization, artificial intelligence, and data analytics to optimize exploration operations.

The Requirements

  • Bachelor’s and Master’s degree in a relevant Geoscience discipline from an accredited institution; PhD preferred
  • Minimum of 15 years’ experience in geology within the mining industry, including 10–15 years in mineral exploration and development with a strong emphasis on greenfield targeting and grassroots exploration
  • At least 3 years in a management or leadership role, overseeing exploration teams and projects
  • Proven multi-commodity and multi-jurisdiction exploration background, with demonstrated expertise in copper, nickel, zinc, lithium, silver, gold, and rare earth element (REE) systems, particularly within Archean crustal environments
  • Strong understanding of mineral deposit geology, mineral systems, and the challenges of discovery under cover
  • Hands-on experience across at least two major exploration terrains or belts, and deep technical knowledge of at least two commodities, with working knowledge of at least two others or advanced understanding of specific exploration processes
  • Direct experience with multiple mineralization styles, including porphyry copper-gold and magmatic nickel-copper systems
  • Proficient in a full range of exploration methods and capable of selecting the most effective techniques based on project needs and context
  • Significant exposure to known deposits through extensive field visits or mine site secondments
  • Strong commitment to maintaining and promoting high safety standards in field operations
  • Highly skilled in field analysis, mapping, sampling, geological documentation, reporting, and mentoring of junior geoscientists
  • Demonstrated experience in identifying and interpreting geoscientific and geophysical datasets across multiple scales
  • Strong project management capabilities, including strategic planning, budgeting, work planning, and team coordination

The Rewards

  • The position offers a competitive remuneration package. Lodgings are modern and secure.
  • FIFO roster

Contact Us

Please apply directly by submitting your resume, preferably as a Microsoft Word document.

title: Consultant
description:
This role can be in Sao Paulo or Rio.

Heidrick Consulting Brazil

You would be part of our Consulting Practice in Brazil. At Heidrick Consulting, we work with Senior Leadership, Executive Teams, and Boards, covering major national and multi-national companies across all industry sectors in Brazil and Latin America.

You will be joining a growing, dynamic team, and in this role as an Engagement Leader, you will expand and deepen your consulting skills by leading various projects as well as managing junior team members. Your contributions will expose you to senior leaders across a variety of industries and geographies.

Primary Responsibilities

The main purpose of the Consultant is to develop consulting solutions as part of client engagements, to write proposals and support business development activities, to act as engagement manager on specific projects and to support Principals and Partners in their delivery.

You will begin to lead, manage, and own problem-solving efforts on a large portion of a client engagement or to lead on smaller engagements. Specifically, you will be responsible for identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analysis, and then synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. Throughout an engagement, you will be involved in discussions and presentations with senior client leadership.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Gathering, analyzing and interpreting data and information; generating insights from analyses.
  • Preparing and presenting information and insights in an impactful and compelling way to help drive client insights and engagement delivery.
  • Delivering a range of consulting solutions, preparing reports and other deliverables that meet client needs.
  • Facilitating and working with client teams with a client first mindset, managing and designing client sessions.
  • Ensuring work is “client ready” (e.g., error free, aligned with expectations, ready to be shared with client) and actively managing expectations with the team.
  • Planning and prioritizing work ensuring team deadlines and quality standards are met.
  • Contributing to proposals (e.g., supporting content development of project design and approaches and case studies) and mobilizing ‘won’ initiatives.
  • Building and sharing reusable, client ready materials, insights (including case studies) and project learnings.
  • Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.
  • Contributing to thought leadership and supporting the development of product, tools, and methodologies.
  • Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.

The Ideal Candidate:

Passionate and Engaged: Will bring a genuine enthusiasm for serving a broad variety of organizations on strategic people and talent topics, including leadership and team development, succession planning, Board effectiveness and organizational culture change.

Self-Driven and Inquisitive: Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.

Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player: Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.

Minimum Role Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of professional work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a management, strategy or leadership consulting environment.
  • An undergraduate degree is required.
  • Experience working directly with clients in a professional service, team-based environment.
  • Ability to drive workload independently within a broader team project setting.
  • Ability to manage time effectively, being comfortable with handling multiple priorities and being able to adapt to changing business needs.
  • Demonstrated advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel and Word; easily able to adopt new technologies and software.
  • Excellent communication skills; writing skills with a proven track record of success preparing concise and compelling reports and other client ready deliverables.
  • Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese. Other languages are a plus.
  • Willingness to travel locally and globally as required.

Buscamos uma liderança sênior que domine a contabilidade com profundidade e atue com protagonismo no suporte às decisões da empresa, tendo forte interação com áreas pares, garantindo a integridade, conformidade e eficiência das informações financeiras da empresa, sendo agente de transformação na estruturação de processos, sistemas e controles e reestruturações estratégicas, promovendo a padronização e a escalabilidade destes.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão?

• Assinar as demonstrações financeiras da companhia como contador responsável (CRC ativo obrigatório).

• Liderar o processo de fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual, com precisão, pontualidade e compliance, assegurando conformidade com CPCs, IFRS e exigências da SEC.

• Garantir o atendimento às auditorias externas (PCAOB) com alto padrão de qualidade e governança.

• Consolidar as demonstrações financeiras da companhia e preparar os reportes ao controlador internacional conforme regras globais.

• Elaborar e revisar notas explicativas às demonstrações financeiras, com ênfase na Nota 08 – Instrumentos Financeiros e Política de Hedge, abrangendo a contabilização de derivativos, aplicação de hedge accounting (cash flow e fair value hedge), gestão de exposições cambiais e riscos de mercado.

• Atuar como referência técnica em normas contábeis, com domínio em: IFRS 16 – Arrendamentos, CPC 25 – Provisões, Passivos Contingentes e Ativos Contingentes, e CPC 27 – Ativo Imobilizado.

• Liderar a estruturação e manutenção de políticas contábeis e controles internos relacionados às rotinas contábeis.

• Promover a transformação da área contábil, reestruturando processos, times e entregas com foco em compliance, eficiência e escalabilidade.

• Ser protagonista nas interações com áreas pares, promovendo soluções conjuntas e sinergias nos processos de fechamento e reporte.

• Liderar, desenvolver e engajar o time contábil, com foco em performance e entregas confiáveis.

• Contribuir com a implementação e/ou evolução de sistemas ERP, com uso intensivo de SAP (preferencialmente), incluindo histórico de participação em projetos.

• Apoiar a jornada de fortalecimento da governança corporativa e crescimento sustentável da organização, combinando visão estratégica e conhecimento técnico.

Para isso, precisamos que você possua:

• Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, com registro ativo no CRC (obrigatório).

• Pós-graduação em Controladoria, Finanças ou áreas correlatas de Business.

• Inglês avançado, com fluência verbal e escrita para comunicação com auditorias e stakeholders internacionais.

• Desejável: Especialização ou certificação formal em normas internacionais de contabilidade (IFRS).

• Experiência em contabilidade de empresas de capital aberto no Brasil e/ou exterior.

• Desejável vivência em processos de IPO ou ambiente pré-IPO.

• Passagem por Big Four será considerada um diferencial relevante.

• Domínio das normas IFRS e CPCs aplicáveis.

• Vivência com ERP SAP e experiência em implementação ou melhorias de sistemas.

• Perfil de liderança colaborativa, com forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e orientação para soluções.

• Mentalidade de transformação e protagonismo, com atuação técnica sólida e visão estratégica de longo prazo.

Local de Trabalho: Zona Oeste (Rio de Janeiro)

Formato de Trabalho: Presencial

title: Analista de Inteligência de Negócios Sênior | Loyalty
description:
Descrição da vaga

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A. está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Avaliar e conectar hipóteses levantadas sobre comportamento do cliente, uso e emissão de pontos, frequência de compra, ticket e demais indicadores de negócio;
  • Levantar oportunidades de melhoria e de testes, com foco em resultado;
  • Apoiar a definição de abordagens de mensuração (uplift, testes A/B, comparação temporal);
  • Criar análises pontuais via SQL para validação de hipóteses;
  • Ajudar na preparação de materiais executivos com clareza e estrutura.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Experiência em estratégia de clientes, fidelidade, CRM ou produtos orientados a comportamento;
  • Boa leitura de indicadores como GMV, margem, ativação, LTV, dentre outros;
  • SQL (intermediário).

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Python.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos emails e no spam.

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

Somos adeptos ao regime e benefícios CLT, oferecemos:

  • Vale Refeição;
  • Plano de saúde Bradesco;
  • Plano odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Fazemos nossa proposta salarial de acordo com o nosso plano de cargos e salários, sua pretensão salarial e avaliação técnica;
  • Somos uma Empresa Cidadã: 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias licença paternidade;
  • Descontos em nossas lojas físicas, após o período de experiência;
  • Ambiente colaborativo: perfeito pra ensinar e aprender muito.

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro - RJ.

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas, de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Engenheiro de dados Senior
description:

title: Coordenador de Obras Sênior - Construção civil
description:
Cargo: Coordenador de Obras Sênior em Construção Civil (Niterói/RJ)

Sobre a Full Tec Engenharia:

A Full Tec Engenharia é uma empresa inovadora e em constante crescimento, especializada em reformas de teatros e gestão de obras cênicas. Buscamos sempre entregar projetos de alta qualidade, prezando pela inovação e melhoria contínua. Se você é um profissional de Engenharia Civil com experiência em executar obras, apaixonado pela área e deseja desenvolver suas habilidades em um ambiente dinâmico, essa oportunidade é para você!

Descrição da vaga:

Estamos em busca de um profissional experiente e altamente capacitado para liderar a execução de obras na área de construção civil. O(a) Coordenador(a) de Obras Sênior será responsável por planejar, gerenciar, controlar e otimizar todas as etapas das obras, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, cumprimento de prazos e orçamentos, além de assegurar conformidade com as normas técnicas, de segurança e sustentabilidade.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Planejar, organizar e controlar todas as atividades de execução de obras civis no canteiro, alinhando-se ao cronograma global do projeto.

  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança do trabalho, licenças ambientais, normas técnicas (ABNT, ASTM, etc.) e políticas internas.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho, como produtividade, desperdício, qualidade e segurança, propondo ações corretivas.
  • Controlar a documentação técnica, registros, relatórios diários e demais registros do andamento da obra.
  • Fiscalizar a execução técnica, verificando se os trabalhos estão de acordo com os projetos, especificações e normativas.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros, garantindo a entrega de materiais e serviços conforme o cronograma.
  • Realizar reuniões de alinhamento e acompanhamento junto às equipes e stakeholders.
  • Promover melhorias contínuas nos processos de obras, com foco em eficiência, segurança e sustentabilidade.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Engenharia Civil ou correlatas
  • Possuir no mínimo 10 anos de experiência em obras de Construção civil abrangentes.
  • Experiência sólida na coordenação de obras de construção civil, preferencialmente em obras de grande porte ou de alta complexidade.
  • Conhecimento avançado de técnicas construtivas, gestão de cronogramas, custos, produtividade e controle de qualidade.
  • Familiaridade com legislação e normas técnicas aplicáveis à construção civil (ABNT, NBR, NR, etc.).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de obras e softwares de controle (MS Project, AutoCAD, ERP, etc.).
  • Perfil de liderança, capacidade de resolução de problemas, comunicação eficiente e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão e gerenciar equipes multidisciplinares de forma motivadora.
  • Estar disponível para viagens.

Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação, especializações na área de Gestão de Obras ou Engenharia de Produção.
  • Certificações como PMP, Lean Construction, Six Sigma ou similares.
  • Inglês técnico.
  • Experiência com obras sustentáveis ou certificados ambientais.

Remuneração:

  • á combinar entre as partes e de acordo com a forma de contratação pactuada, e experiência.

Local de Trabalho: Sede – Niterói/RJ

Como se Candidatar: Envie seu currículo atualizado para com o assunto "Vaga de Coordenador de obras sênior”. As candidaturas serão aceitas até 20/08/2025.

Full Tec Engenharia – Inovação e Qualidade em Cada Projeto!

title: Profissional Backend .Net
description:

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu porcesso de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

  • Desenvolver, manter e otimizar soluções de infraestrutura Linux on-premises para sistemas de missão crítica.
  • Gerenciar e implementar ambientes virtualizados, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e alta disponibilidade.
  • Manter e integrar APIs Java, aplicações Angular, fluxos Camunda BPM e Cisco NSO.
  • Implementar e dar suporte a mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka) e bancos de dados relacionais/não relacionais.
  • Criar automações com Ansible e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Administrar redes, VPNs, ACLs, VLANs e configurar segurança, monitoramento e observabilidade.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e infraestrutura na melhoria contínua e confiabilidade dos ambientes.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Administração de sistemas Linux (Red Hat, CentOS, Ubuntu) em ambientes críticos on-premises.
  • Virtualização (VMware ou similares), alta disponibilidade e clusters.
  • Dockerização de aplicações (APIs Java, Angular, mensageria).
  • Automação de infraestrutura (Ansible, Terraform, Shell/Python), pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins).
  • Redes avançadas: IP, subnetting, roteamento, VLANs, VPNs, NAT, ACLs, DNS, troubleshooting e integração com Cisco.
  • Load balancing e escalabilidade (NGINX ou similares).
  • Mensageria corporativa (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MariaDB, Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis).
  • Integração e suporte a APIs Java, Angular e Camunda BPM.
  • Monitoramento (Zabbix ou similares).
  • Segurança de infraestrutura (hardening, firewalls, controle de acesso, segregação de ambientes).
  • Bancos relacionais e não relacionais, automações com Ansible e pipelines CI/CD
  • Versionamento e IaC com Git e Terraform.

Acreditamos na troca de experiências e valorizamos as relações através do Regime Híbrido, 2x na semana

Our commitment to innovative solutions and determination to overcome complex challenges have positioned us as a trusted partner in significant offshore projects across the globe. Driven by a spirit of exploration, we are also expanding into groundbreaking initiatives within the renewable energy industry.

title: ISA Platinion Recruiting Senior Specialist
description:
Locations : Brazil | Santiago
Who We Are
BCG pioneered strategy consulting more than 50 years ago, and we continue to innovate and redefine the industry. We offer multiple career paths for the world’s best talent to have a real impact on business and society. As part of our team, you will benefit from the breadth and diversity of what we are doing today and where we are headed next. We count on your authenticity, exceptional work, and strong integrity. In return we are committed to supporting you in discovering the most fulfilling career journey possible—and unlocking your potential to advance the world.
The Business Services Team (BST) consists of various functional professionals, including our business management and operations team members, who work to ensure that BCG is running smoothly, efficiently, and productively. Members of this team contribute directly to the success of our business through a number of roles, including executive and administrative assistants, visual service artists, receptionists, facilities staff, and the team leaders and office coordinators who manage these operations and business management jobs.
What You'll Do
As an ISA Platinion Recruiting Senior Specialist you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of recruiting activities for experienced hires in Brazil for the BCG Platinion businesses in São Paulo and providing support to our SSA offices (Argentina, Chile, Colombia and Peru) when needed. You will act as a trusted advisor to identify, recruit, and hire top talent for BCG Platinion and will own and drive the implementation of this strategy and improvements.
As an ISA Platinion Recruiting Senior Specialist you will be expected to have a good understanding of the target groups and how to engage them, working close to the Diversity and Equity Teams. With input from Platinion leadership you will operationalise the sourcing, screening, relationship building, offer preparation and delivery of hiring processes for all candidates in a fast-paced setting. It is critical that you maintain high quality standards and delivers a positive experience for all candidates and key stakeholders at each phase of the recruiting process.
Your tasks will include:
Craft and execute a comprehensive recruitment strategy in collaboration with BCG Platinion's senior leadership and the consulting team.
Take charge of the entire recruitment process, from brand enhancement and candidate sourcing through to successful onboarding. Utilize a variety of cost-effective sourcing channels, including direct outreach, referrals, social media, and job boards, while effectively coordinating with recruitment agencies as needed.
Act as a trusted advisor to our Brazilian and SSA Managing Directors and Senior Partners. Regularly engage with key stakeholders to gather insights, discuss recruitment strategies, and ensure alignment with business needs. Your role will be fundamental in managing relationships and understanding detailed role requirements.
Ensure a seamless, rapid, and uniformly positive experience for all candidates throughout the recruitment process. Act as a primary local contact, facilitating smooth transitions for new hires and providing ongoing support to integrate them into our culture and operations.
Continuously assess and refine our recruitment approaches. Challenge existing processes and innovate new practices that enhance our effectiveness and reduce biases. Lead initiatives aimed at improving our recruitment processes and sharing best practices across the team.
Support recruitment activities beyond Brazil and SSA, foster synergies and share insights across the Platinion EMESA and broader BCG recruiting teams to enhance our global recruitment strategy.
What You'll Bring
6+ years of proven experience in recruitment within a fast-paced, high-performance environment, preferably within consulting or related industries in the technology services space.
Proven experience in recruitment within a fast-paced, high-volume environment, preferably within consulting or related industries.
A deep understanding of the recruitment lifecycle and ability to manage complex stakeholder relationships.
Strong advisory skills with the capability to provide strategic insights and data-driven recommendations to senior leadership.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working collaboratively across diverse teams.
Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish, and English.
Additional info
Lead with strong business acumen and a proactive approach, taking ownership of projects and pushing boundaries for continuous improvement.
Maintain a streamlined system and adeptly managing simultaneous tasks in high-pressure situations.
Demonstrate meticulous attention to detail and accuracy, especially under pressure, contributing to flawless execution.
Utilizes interpersonal skills to cultivate lasting partnerships with stakeholders at all levels, from local and international recruiting teams to consulting staff and HR within BCG.
Combine creative sourcing strategies and clear, effective communication to engage top talent in competitive markets and drive key strategies forward.

English .

Sobre a ZEISS:

Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage

(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)

Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance

Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.

We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility

What We’re Looking For:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required; Portuguese or Spanish is a plus

Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering

Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture

Who is Xelvin?

Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.

Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!

As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.

What do we offer?

Contract wise:

· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)

Onboarding & benefits:

· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.

· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.

· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.

· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.

· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.

· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;

o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.

o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food.

title: Foreman
description:
Foreman – UAE

Are you a hands-on site leader with a strong commitment to quality, safety, and daily execution excellence?

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who We are?

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Foreman, you’ll take frontline responsibility for executing daily site activities safely, efficiently, and to the highest quality standards. You’ll lead your team on the ground, translating technical drawings into action and ensuring work progresses according to project plans.

At ALEC, we’re about more than just building iconic structures, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner on some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value reliability, innovation, and our people. Join us to lead high-performing site teams that drive delivery excellence.

About Your Team

You’ll report to the Senior Foreman and work closely with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors, and supporting departments including QA/QC and planning. You’ll lead a small team of operatives and coordinate resources to maintain daily momentum and deliver consistent progress.

Your Role

As a Foreman, you will:

  • Lead daily site activities, ensuring works are delivered safely, on time, and to the required quality.
  • Coordinate labour, materials, and equipment to optimise workflow and minimise downtime.
  • Enforce ALEC safety protocols and foster a culture of compliance and awareness.
  • Read and interpret drawings to ensure correct execution and alignment with design intent.
  • Monitor progress and take corrective action to overcome site-level challenges.
  • Maintain accurate records of progress and workforce deployment.
  • Support and motivate your team, resolve on-site issues, and escalate where required.
  • Contribute to improvements in efficiency, cost control, and construction methods.
  • This is a full-time role following a Monday to Saturday work week typical of site-based positions in our industry.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years in a Foreman or similar site-based supervisory role within the GCC.
  • Technical Knowledge: Practical understanding of construction activities, materials, and sequencing.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to guide and manage small site teams effectively.
  • Communication: Clear verbal and written communication with team members and engineers.
  • Skills: Skilled in site planning, resource coordination, and drawing interpretation.
  • Safety-First Mindset: Strong awareness of HSE principles and site compliance.
  • Tools: Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); First Aider certification preferred.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

title: Engenheiro / Técnico de Serviços de Campo - Microscopia | RJ
description:
Sobre a ZEISS:

- Fundada como uma fábrica para mecânica de precisão e óptica na cidade de Jena, Alemanha, em 1846, a Carl Zeiss é hoje um líder mundial nas indústrias óptica e optoeletrônica. Temos escritórios em mais de 30 países e somos representados em mais de 100 países, com centros de produção na Europa, América do Norte, América Central e na Ásia.

- Nossa tarefa mais importante é levar os usuários da tecnologia ZEISS a áreas que permaneceram escondidas no passado. Nós somos líderes de mercado na maioria dos campos onde atuamos. Oferecemos um espectro extraordinário de soluções inteligentes e produtos nas áreas de Tecnologia Médica, Tecnologia em Metrologia Industrial e Tecnologia em Microscopia.

Sobre a nossa Divisão de Microscopia:

- Como o maior fabricante de sistemas de microscópios, nós oferecemos soluções completas para pesquisa biomédica, para o setor de saúde e as indústrias de alta tecnologia. Cientistas famosos conquistaram o Prêmio Nobel e outras premiações por seus trabalhos com a ajuda de nossos produtos.

Base de Trabalho - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

- Executar atividades de instalação e manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos comercializados pela empresa.

- Assegurar o adequado funcionamento dos equipamentos instalados nos clientes para evitar paradas operacionais, através da adequada interpretação dos dados e uso do conhecimento/ instruções técnicas, atuando conforme as diretrizes e métricas de qualidade, produtividade, atendimento, custos e segurança, saúde e meio ambiente.

Principais Responsabilidades:

- Seguir procedimentos e diretrizes preestabelecidas para instalação, manutenção, e conserto de produtos ou equipamentos adquiridos pelos clientes da empresa, contribuindo na melhoria dos mesmos.

- Instalar, prestar serviços de manutenção, ministrar treinamento a cliente e atualizar equipamentos em conformidade com instruções detalhadas e pedidos ordem de serviço.

- Fornecer manutenção programada nas instalações do cliente para assegurar o funcionamento contínuo e confiável dos equipamentos.

- Manter registros precisos dos serviços executados, a fim de cumprir com metas de desempenho individual e garantir que o desempenho do equipamento pode ser monitorado.

- Garantir a satisfação do cliente quanto às soluções de manutenção, de acordo com as métricas de atendimento, prazo, performance e qualidade definidas pela área.

- Desenvolver conhecimento dos produtos e serviços da empresa através de trabalho em conjunto com outros membros do time de Serviços (engenheiros e técnicos iniciantes) .

- Elaborar e enviar relatórios de serviços para cada atendimento realizado.

- Graduação na área de Engenharia.

- Conhecimentos básicos em TI (formatar hardware, instalar softwares, configurar redes).

- Inglês Avançado.

- CNH em dia.

- Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais.

Experiência necessária:

- Experiência anterior com instalação e manutenção de equipamentos eletrotécnicos, e serviços de campo. Conhecimento ou experiência prévia com microscópios (eletrônicos, de luz, raio X e a laser) será um diferencial.

A ZEISS acredita na igualdade de oportunidades. Independentemente de gênero, idade, raça, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência, todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas em nossos processos seletivos. Trabalhamos para construir um ambiente diverso e com equidade de

title: Analista Sênior em Operações de RH
description:

Atuar de forma estratégica e analítica nas áreas de Controladoria e Planejamento Financeiro, com foco no monitoramento da performance econômico-financeira. description:

title: Digital Construction Coordinator
description:
Digital Construction Coordinator - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Coordinator, you'll be responsible for managing information using BIM (Building Information Modelling) across a construction project. The role ensures stakeholders meet digital deliverables and information requirements, with a primary focus on BIM, though it may also involve broader digital techniques like scanning and drones.

Your Role:

  • Communicate and manage internal/external information requirements
  • Help develop and maintain BIM execution plans, responsibility matrices, and other key documents
  • Configure and support common data environments (CDE) and EDMS
  • Oversee 3D model coordination, clash detection, and issue reporting
  • Provide training and support on BIM tools and processes
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models
  • Assist with resource estimation, tendering, and reporting
  • Support digital initiatives and improvements with the Head of Digital Construction

What We're looking For

  • Solid understanding of ISO 19650 and previous standards (e.g., PAS 1192)
  • Proficiency in BIM tools (e.g., Revit, Navisworks, Revizto)
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie)
  • Experience with CDE platforms (e.g., Aconex, BIM 360)
  • Skills in automation tools (Solibri, Dynamo, Python)
  • Experience with 4D/5D modeling and Power BI for data reporting
  • Strong communication and collaboration
  • Detail-oriented and analytical
  • Confident, resilient, and proactive
  • Passion for digital transformation in construction

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV in English)

Electrify Your Career with StarCharge South America

At StarCharge South America, we're not just supplying chargers — we’re enabling the infrastructure behind clean mobility future. Our portfolio ranges from smart home AC chargers to high-performance DC solutions for commercial and public networks. With V2G-ready technology, our products are shaping the next generation of energy ecosystems. But more than products, we’re building momentum. And we want you in the driver’s seat.

Establish and maintain long-term partnerships with local contractors and oversee their performance. Maintain close communication with local governments and financial institutions to ensure compliant project operations.

4.Research and stay updated on local grid policies, energy regulations, and market trends to ensure that company products and solutions comply with local legal and regulatory requirements.

5.Conduct market analysis on industry trends, competitors, and customer needs. Provide regular sales progress and market analysis reports to headquarters. Participate in local industry associations to enhance company visibility and reputation.

6.Lead local team building and management efforts. Organize and deliver relevant training programs to enhance team capabilities and performance.

Requirements:

1.Education background: Bachelor’s degree or above in any discipline; majors in electrical engineering, power systems, energy management, or related fields are preferred.

2.Work experience: At least 3 years of experience in developing and delivering renewable energy projects such as energy storage, solar PV, or wind power. Experience with Chinese companies is a plus. Willingness to travel internationally is required.

3.Policy Knowledge: Familiar with local grid policies, energy regulations, and market trends in the target South America country. Ability to adapt business strategies in response to policy changes.

4.Technical background: Solid understanding of power systems and energy storage technologies. Ability to comprehend and clearly explain both technical and commercial solutions to clients.

5.Communication and negotiation skills: Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients and team members.

6.Language skills: Fluent in both Chinese and English, capable of conducting technical and business negotiations.

7.Residential background: Long-term residence in South America with a deep understanding of local culture, business environment, and networks.

title: Risk Management Professional - Consultor(a) Sênior (Modelagem de Dados)
description:
Descrição do perfil

Responsável por suportar a definição dos critérios de risco corporativos da empresa, gerenciar as ferramentas de suporte ao processo ERM, identificar gap analysis para uma gestão efetiva do processo, assim como realizar a atualização dos critérios de avaliação quantitativa dos riscos relevantes.

Principais atividades

  • Aplicar técnicas avançadas de modelagem estatística para avaliar e prever o impacto de riscos em diferentes cenários organizacionais;
  • Identificar, mapear e avaliar riscos, operacionais e estratégicos, utilizando tanto dados internos quanto externos, para assegurar na mitigação de potenciais ameaças;
  • Criar e implementar modelos estatísticos para suportar decisões estratégicas;
  • Conduzir análises de cenários e sensibilidade para entender como diferentes variáveis e incertezas impactam os objetivos organizacionais;
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos detalhados e dashboards, além de apresentações para alta gestão, oferecendo recomendações estratégicas baseadas em dados quantitativos e modelos de risco.

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação:

  • Inglês avançado;
  • Domínio de técnicas quantitativas de análise de riscos e modelagem financeira, com foco em modelagem estatística e análise probabilística;
  • Experiência em gestão quantitativa de riscos, preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte ou em consultorias especializadas no setor de telecomunicações;
  • Experiência com análise de sensibilidade e análise de Monte Carlo;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise e modelagem de riscos;
  • Formação superior completa em Matemática;
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA será considerado um diferencial.

Local de Trabalho: Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro - RJ.

title: Supervisor de TAX Indiretos
description:
Sobre a área

A Consultoria Tributária é a ponte entre a complexidade das leis fiscais e as decisões estratégicas das empresas. Atuamos com foco em inteligência fiscal, identificando oportunidades de economia, mitigações de riscos e garantindo o compliance com a legislação. É uma área dinâmica, que combina análise técnica, visão de negócio e proximidade com o cliente — ideal para quem gosta de desafios, atualização constante e impacto direto nos resultados das organizações.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar projetos de revisão fiscal e apuração de tributos indiretos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS), assegurando o correto cumprimento das obrigações tributárias.
  • Identificar riscos fiscais e oportunidades de recuperação de créditos e eficiência tributária, com foco consultivo e estratégico.
  • Realizar a interpretação e análise de documentos fiscais, contábeis e societários, aplicando conhecimento técnico às operações tributárias indiretas.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos com clareza e objetividade, evidenciando impactos financeiros e recomendações práticas.
  • Apoiar clientes na compreensão e adequação à legislação, traduzindo pontos técnicos em linguagem acessível.
  • Fazer a ponte entre clientes, sócios e demais áreas da empresa (contábil, legal, financeira), promovendo um trabalho colaborativo.
  • Supervisionar as entregas da equipe (analistas e consultores juniores), promovendo desenvolvimento técnico e garantindo a qualidade dos trabalhos.
  • Participar de propostas comerciais, reuniões com clientes e contribuir para o fortalecimento da área de TAX Indiretos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação superior completa em Contabilidade, Direito, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em apuração, revisão e planejamento de tributos indiretos.
  • Domínio das legislações de ICMS, IPI, PIS e COFINS, e dos regimes tributários: Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e Simples Nacional.
  • Vivência em revisão de compliance fiscal, levantamento de créditos tributários e regimes especiais é um diferencial.
  • Excel em nível intermediário ou avançado.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para lidar com diferentes interlocutores.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado é desejável.

Competências comportamentais:

  • Capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Proatividade e perfil hands-on.
  • Liderança e foco em desenvolvimento de equipe.
  • Organização e foco em resultados.

Benefícios

  • Convênio com o SESC;
  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida

title: Digital Construction Engineer
description:
Digital Construction Engineer - UAE

Are you a tech-savvy professional with a passion for digital innovation in construction? Step into a pivotal role where you’ll drive information management excellence using BIM and shape the future of digital delivery on high-profile projects across the UAE.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.

  • Sau Paulo, Brazil
  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Bogota, Columbia

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Digital Construction Engineer, you will be responsible for driving and supporting the implementation of information management processes using Building Information Modelling (BIM) across the lifecycle of a construction project. You will serve as a key liaison between the project management team and external stakeholders (consultants, subcontractors, and clients), ensuring digital deliverables and information workflows align with project and client requirements. While your core focus will be on BIM and data coordination, your scope may also include supporting digital construction technologies such as 3D scanning, drones, field data capture, and robotics. You will play an active role in embedding digital best practices and contributing to the project's digital strategy from planning through handover.

Your Role:

  • Support development and communication of BIM and information requirements.
  • Assist in preparing and maintaining project documentation (BEP, MIDP, EIR, LAP, etc.).
  • Configure and maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows in EDMS platforms.
  • Set up BIM workflows and coordinate 3D models, identifying and resolving clashes.
  • Provide BIM training and guidance to internal departments.
  • Conduct QA/QC checks on models for internal teams and subcontractors.
  • Support digital tendering efforts and contribute to project-level digital reporting.
  • Represent BIM in project coordination and progress meetings.
  • Collaborate on the development of standards, templates, and digital procedures.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and BS 1192.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring tools (e.g., Revit, Tekla, Archicad).
  • Experience in BIM coordination tools (e.g., Navisworks, Revizto).
  • Familiarity with openBIM standards (IFC, COBie) and model checking (e.g., Solibri).
  • Knowledge of CDE platforms (Aconex, BIM 360) and scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera).
  • Visual programming (Dynamo) and Power BI experience preferred.
  • Understanding of 4D/5D BIM workflows and outputs.
  • Strong communicator with collaborative mindset.
  • Detail-oriented, analytical, and proactive.
  • Resilient under pressure with strong time management.
  • Passionate about digital innovation in construction.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Ready to elevate your surveying career?

Apply now and be part of ALEC’s legacy of excellence. (attach your CV)

title: Gerente de Sistemas

Por isso esperamos que você possua:

title: Engenheiro de Manutenção Elétrica Senior
description:
Brunel está em busca de um Engenheiro de Manutenção Elétrica Sênior para atuar em uma empresa líder do setor de óleo e gás.

Este(a) profissional será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade e a segurança dos sistemas elétricos offshore, conduzindo análises técnicas, coordenando intervenções de manutenção e assegurando a conformidade com normas regulatórias, especialmente NR-10.

Além disso, atuará como referência técnica em processos de Management of Change (MoC) e em projetos de retrofit de equipamentos elétricos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar análises de causa raiz para identificação de falhas recorrentes e melhoria da confiabilidade dos ativos;
  • Planejar e coordenar intervenções de terceiros e operações de manutenção, participando ativamente de reuniões operacionais e de campo;
  • Garantir a gestão eficiente de peças sobressalentes alinhadas às demandas operacionais;
  • Assegurar que todas as atividades de manutenção elétrica estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e ambientais;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de estratégias de manutenção preditiva e preventiva;
  • Atualizar e revisar estudos técnicos como Balanço de Potência, Estudos de Proteção e Memoriais Descritivos;
  • Monitorar o cumprimento da NR-10, acompanhando não conformidades e oferecendo suporte técnico quando necessário;
  • Avaliar tecnicamente e conduzir processos de Management of Change (MoC) na disciplina elétrica;
  • Antecipar possíveis falhas em colaboração com outras áreas, minimizando riscos e paradas não planejadas.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica com registro ativo no CREA (pré-requisito para atuar como PLH);
  • Experiência sólida em manutenção de instalações de produção de óleo e gás;
  • Proficiência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento básico dos processos de tratamento de óleo e gás e domínio dos equipamentos envolvidos;
  • Vivência com sistemas de potência elétrica: disjuntores, painéis, transformadores, motores HV/LV, retificadores, inversores, bancos de baterias, relés de proteção e geradores;
  • Conhecimento das normas NR-10, NR-37 e familiaridade com diretrizes IEx;
  • Desejável conhecimento em SAP;
  • Perfil proativo, analítico e com forte capacidade de trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.
